Subject: MAP draft + stakeholder RACI — FinCo / Redwood

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the proposed milestones, owners, dependencies, and a target close date. Key items for you to confirm:

- Target close: 2026-07-15 (flexible based on procurement timeline)
- Milestones: PoC kickoff, security review, legal review & contract signature, pilot go-live
- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence (summary attached), procurement PO, engineering integration window

Could you please:
1) Confirm the economic buyer for this deal
2) Confirm the security owner and the person who will own evidence collection for SOC2
3) Confirm the legal owner who will shepherd contract review
4) Confirm the eng lead who will work with our SRE/Integration team

I've also stamped the MAP with tentative milestone dates; happy to adjust once we have stakeholder availability. Next step from our side: Marissa will set up a 30-min sync with your security and legal reps to agree evidence scope.

Attachments: FinCo_MAP_Draft_v0.1.xlsx, SOC2_Attestation_summary.pdf

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Ben —

Thanks for the MAP — looks good at a high level. Quick answers below:

- Economic buyer: Anjali Mehta (SVP, Product) — anjali.mehta@fincobank.com
- Security owner: Carlos Ruiz (Head of InfoSec) — carlos.ruiz@fincobank.com (cc'd)
- Legal owner: Maya Singh (Contracts Lead) — maya.singh@fincobank.com (will join next thread)
- Eng lead: Daniel Park (Principal Engineer, Integrations) — daniel.park@fincobank.com

A couple of clarifying notes:
- Procurement will likely need a formal quote + standard T&Cs before PO; target for us to have contract materially complete by 7/8 so we can issue PO by 7/12
- Carlos: can you confirm whether a SOC2 attest is sufficient or if you need more detailed test-plant evidence?

I'm traveling this week but can join the sync on Thu morning if needed. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

—Samir

Samir —

Perfect, thanks for the fast clarity. I've updated the MAP owners based on your notes (attached new version v0.2) and moved the procurement milestone to target contract complete by 2026-07-08. Marissa will send a calendar invite for Thu 10:00am PT to cover security + legal scope (Carlos + Maya).

Neha — can you confirm the evidence we typically provide for SOC2 reviews and whether "SOC2 Attestation + control summary" is sufficient for Carlos's team? If not, please call out any additional artifacts and an estimate for when we can deliver them.

Rishi — FYI on the tentative integration windows (we'll need a 2-week engineering window for the pilot integration; see MAP). Are you able to commit a short discovery with Daniel to scope the work next week?

Next steps (owned):
- Marissa: send calendar invite + agenda (owner: marissa@redwood.ai)
- Neha: confirm evidence package and delivery ETA (owner: neha@redwood.ai)
- Rishi: schedule discovery with Daniel (owner: rishi@redwood.ai)
- Ben: update MAP + share HubSpot deal link

Attachment: FinCo_MAP_Draft_v0.2.xlsx

Thanks team —
Ben
